customer_message.body:
Good afternoon

Before any firm classification: I have lived here for 17 years and need a lift and a step-free shower; Six of nine enquiries were rejected; The manager says everyone must leave but sent only a general project brochure; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship”, my first account covers: the works schedule remains unresolved; for the request “review the renovation reason and schedule and prepare an extension request with documented housing searches”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship”, I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the vacant possession need; I would like this position reviewed.

My question is: review the renovation reason and schedule and prepare an extension request with documented housing searches; in particular, I need clarity about the vacant possession need and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; I need a clear reply about the works schedule; I can then decide how to proceed.

I became aware of the problem on 07 July 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Several details remain unclear: renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship
